intents.name: pricing_plan
intents.answer:
💳 *DLF Pricing & Payment Schemes — Comprehensive Bifurcation:*

💰 *1. Price Guidance by Property Segment:*
• *Independent Luxury Floors (DLF City / Alameda):* ₹2.80 Cr – ₹6.50 Cr (Avg. ₹12,000 – ₹18,000 / sq.ft.)
• *Luxury High-Rise (Privana / Arbour / One Midtown):* ₹3.80 Cr – ₹12.50 Cr (Avg. ₹18,000 – ₹25,000 / sq.ft.)
• *Super Luxury Flagships (The Dahlias / The Camellias):* ₹25.00 Cr – ₹100.00+ Cr (Avg. ₹50,000 – ₹85,000+ / sq.ft.)

📝 *2. Official Booking Token Amounts:*
• *Independent Floors:* ₹5 Lakhs – ₹10 Lakhs
• *Luxury Apartments (Arbour / Privana / Midtown):* ₹10 Lakhs – ₹25 Lakhs
• *Super Luxury Residences (Dahlias / Camellias):* ₹50 Lakhs – ₹1.00 Crore

📑 *3. Structured Payment Plans:*
1. *Construction-Linked Plan (CLP):* Staged 10% milestone disbursements tied to foundation, floor casting, MEP, and finishing.
2. *Possession-Linked Plan (PLP / 25:75):* Pay 25% upfront, balance 75% on offer of possession.
3. *Down Payment Plan (DPP):* Upfront settlement with attractive developer rebate.

🏦 *4. Pre-Approved Banking Partners:*
Instant loan sanction and preferential interest rates from:
• *State Bank of India (SBI)* • *HDFC Bank* • *ICICI Bank* • *Axis Bank* • *Kotak Mahindra Bank*

👉 *Tap 'Request a Callback' to receive an exact unit-level cost sheet with tax & stamp duty breakdown!*

intents.name: rera_approvals
intents.answer:
📜 *DLF RERA Approvals & Legal Transparency:*

Every DLF residential and commercial project is developed with 100% legal compliance, clear freehold ownership, and statutory state RERA registrations.

🏛️ *Official RERA Registration Numbers:*
• *The Dahlias (Gurugram):* HARERA No. `RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/872/604/2024/99` dated 04.10.2024
• *The Arbour (Gurugram):* HARERA No. `RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/671/403/2023/15` dated 23.02.2023
• *DLF Privana South (Gurugram):* RERA Registered under HARERA Gurugram (haryanarera.gov.in)
• *One Midtown (New Delhi):* Delhi RERA ID: `DLRERA2021P0007`
• *The Ultima & The Crest:* Fully completed, awarded Occupancy Certificate (OC) • 0% GST applicable

⚖️ *Statutory Buyer Guarantees:*
1. *RERA Escrow Account:* 70% of buyer payments deposited in dedicated project escrow accounts for construction only.
2. *Builder-Buyer Agreement (BBA):* Standardized RERA BBA signed within 30–45 days of booking.
3. *Clear Freehold Title:* DLF projects are built on outright purchased, unencumbered freehold land parcels.
